newsitem.title: UK: Low sulphur straight-run fuel knocked by crude.
newsitem.headline: Low sulphur straight-run fuel knocked by crude.

text.p: Straight-run fuel oil suffered in sympathy with weaker crude although dealers said the sector was still thinly offered and U.S. interest might be resurrected.

Tracking volatile crude, low sulphur straight-run moved in a $5 range, ending down $2-3 at $141-143 fob NWE. Talk of a deal at $156-157 cif NWE was not considered likely with dealers querying where the material was sourced from and why the price was so much above the rest of the market.
Interest was seen into Sweden, but nothing was thought concluded.
